freed_accessibility_description: Detect openings of selected apps to apply your whole-app guards. You choose whether to open FREED recovery. Native Shorts and Reels inspection is experimental and outside the public release.
freed_usage_access_reason: FREED uses Usage Access only to read aggregate foreground time for selected app packages so your app timers can trigger recovery challenges. It does not read screen contents, messages, keystrokes, browsing history, or raw usage events.
freed_dns_channel_description: Shows when FREED's DNS-only adult-domain filter is active.
freed_dns_paused_notification: Filtering paused for this network's sign-in page. Normal browsing stays direct.
freed_dns_active_notification: Adult-domain DNS filtering is active. Normal browsing stays direct.
freed_browser_channel_description: Shows protection notices for supported blocks. FREED recovery opens only when you choose.
freed_accessibility_notification: Open FREED to complete a recovery challenge. No overlays, screenshots, or OCR are used.
freed_dns_intervention_channel_descripti: Shows when FREED blocks an adult-domain DNS request. Recovery opens only when you choose.
freed_dns_intervention_notification: Open FREED to complete a recovery challenge. Normal browsing stays direct.
freed_dns_intervention_title: Hold on — your streak is worth protecting
freed_intervention_title: Hold on. You are still in control.
freed_intervention_subtitle: Your app boundary is active. Choose Start recovery to get support.
freed_usage_title: Usage Access stays limited to app timers.
freed_usage_note: Usage Access is controlled by Android Settings. After enabling FREED, return to setup so the activation test can verify protection.
freed_calibration_instruction: Tap the surface to calibrate. Only its stable view fingerprint stays on this device.
freed_calibration_ready: Stable local selector found. Confirm to save it, or cancel to discard it.
freed_companion_hello: One step at a time. You are making room for a better day.
